action: Reject online; queue offline with reason

District maps to the approved district reference
action: Review queue; do not auto-correct unknown values

Email syntax and verification state are separate attributes
action: Reject invalid syntax; do not infer verified status

action: Block optional marketing use without approved basis

rule: Identity match requires exact crosswalk or threshold plus independent evidence
action: Human review; no destructive automatic merge

rule: Canonical SKU resolves to one active product or an approved alias
Unit of measure belongs to the approved unit vocabulary
Category is selected from the current category reference
Order ID and line number form a stable idempotency key
action: Reject duplicate conflicting payload; retry safely

rule: Quantity is numeric; negative quantities require a return/void reason
Currency is an explicit ISO 4217 code and amount has valid precision
action: Quarantine unknown currency or malformed amount

rule: Payment reference is unique per provider unless a documented reversal/split explains reuse
Order timestamp has a timezone or a documented source timezone
Stock event carries SKU
Inventory adjustment has reason code
Incoming workbook has sender
HR extract includes only approved fields for a named purpose
Sensor payload contains aggregate counts and no stable person identifier
action: Reject identifying payload; escalate to privacy focal
